description: Starts a crawl of one of your CookiePal domains on the user’s own computer, using the open-source crawl engine. CookiePal crawls nothing: run upload_scan_report with the result when the crawl finishes, and until then get_scan_report reports it as running. Needs the domain’s banner to be verified and active first, unless this is the very first scan of a domain just added with add_domain. The local run this needs is made only by the CookiePal plugin in a coding agent on the user’s own computer: Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. claude.ai, Claude Code on the web and other cloud agents run in the cloud, so they cannot make it, and a crawler or browser run anywhere else does not stand in for it.

domainId.description: Which domain to scan, such as example.com. Omit it for the account’s default domain.

maxPages.description: How many pages to crawl, up to 50.

name: start_scan
title: Start a local cookie scan
